versions.changelog:
- The skill has been deprecated and renamed from rainman-translate-book to translate-book.
- All scripts and most documentation files have been removed.
- SKILL.md was updated to notify users about the rename and provide migration instructions.
- No new features or bug fixes will be released for this deprecated package.
- Users are advised to uninstall this version and install translate-book for continued support and updates.

Initial release of rainman-translate-book skill.

- Translates entire books (PDF/DOCX/EPUB) into any language using parallel agent workflow.
- Converts input files into Markdown chunks for efficient and scalable translation.
- Supports chunk-by-chunk parallel translation with customizable concurrency (default: 8).
- Maintains Markdown structure, image references, and intelligent heading recognition in outputs.
- Produces results in multiple formats: HTML, DOCX, EPUB, PDF.
- Robust verification and retry logic to ensure complete, high-quality translations.
